facilities.title: Designed for Care, Comfort & Precision
facilities.subtitle: Every corner of NOVA Medical Center is engineered to provide peace of mind, clinical sterility, and patient privacy.

consultation.name: Private Consultation Suites
consultation.description: Ergonomic doctor offices engineered with acoustic privacy, natural lighting, and patient-first consultation desks.
consultation.f1: Acoustically insulated walls for strict patient privacy

imaging.name: Diagnostic Imaging Suite
imaging.description: Equipped with ultra-low radiation digital X-ray and high-resolution ultrasound machines for rapid clinical decisions.
imaging.f2: Digital radiography with instant cloud archival
imaging.f3: Comfortable imaging suites for reduced anxiety

lab.name: Automated Clinical Laboratory
lab.description: An on-site diagnostic laboratory running automated biochemistry, hematology, and rapid hormone tests.
lab.f2: Barcoded specimen tracking ensuring zero error

pharmacy.name: Specialized Outpatient Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: Direct dispensing of prescribed medications, pediatric formulations, and specialized dermatological skincare.
pharmacy.f3: Direct digital prescription transfer from doctors

lounge.name: Executive Waiting Lounges
lounge.description: Serene waiting environments featuring complimentary artisan coffee, high-speed Wi-Fi, and plush seating.
lounge.f1: Quiet ambient lighting and filtered fresh air
lounge.f2: Complimentary refreshments and digital reading material
lounge.f3: Spaced seating layouts ensuring calm and personal space

reception.name: Concierge Reception Desk

reception.f1: Fast touchless check-in and scheduling support
reception.f3: Clear directional signage in English and Arabic
